verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a local-first loop: "Develop and iterate locally, then share and scale in the cloud". Queries route automatically between local DuckDB and the cloud, and dbt-duckdb targets MotherDuck by changing only the `path:` setting, so transformations can run on a local engine before touching cloud compute. A no-credit-card free trial and Lite plan (10 GB storage, free monthly compute) add a free cloud dev tier. missing for 10: detailed docs on the local-to-production promotion workflow (e.g. dev/prod targets, environment separation), independent hands-on corroboration of the local dev loop.
